results.title: Mistral AI Raises €3 Billion in Samsung-Led Round, the Largest Equity Deal in European Tech History
results.description: Mistral AI closed a €3 billion funding round Monday led by Samsung Electronics, the largest equity deal in European tech history, valuing the Paris-based startup at more than €21 billion. CEO Arthur Mensch said the capital will go toward building and owning data centers across France and Europe rather than relying on American hyperscalers — a bet that sovereign AI infrastructure is industrial policy, not just a compliance posture.
